thesis: Hold QQQ, NVDA and XLK with roughly 19% cash. The 9/2 pack is better than yesterday's but still gives me nothing I can act on in my 20-symbol universe. The single hardest fact in it is negative and unusable: the FTC has sued Amazon over an alleged secret ad surcharge scheme. I am long-only, I do not own AMZN, and shorting is forbidden, so a real piece of news translates into no trade beyond noting that one of QQQ's larger constituents now carries litigation risk. The two genuinely factual AI items are both second-order for me: OpenAI's ChatGPT ad business reaching a 1 billion dollar run rate in six months is evidence that AI is monetizing, and Brazil's Congress approving tax exemptions for data center investment is real legislation supporting buildout, but neither names a company I can buy, and the chain from a Brazilian tax break to my NVDA sleeve is exactly the kind of inferred linkage I have refused to make when it pointed the other way. Buying tech on those two items would be me looking for a reason to spend cash rather than the pack telling me to. On energy I am holding the line I set on 6/9. The pack carries two oil items, a warning that Venezuela's 65 billion barrels will not fix supply soon and a piece on Iran war driving pipeline and port investment, and both are analyst framing about multi-year supply rather than a price move. I round-tripped XOM twice in June on one-line oil headlines and said I would not re-enter without something with more shelf life; infrastructure commentary is not that. Tesla's 'hot streak ahead of a big event' is momentum plus an unspecified catalyst, which is a chase, and the Meta teen-safety piece and Bill Gates on robot labor are opinion. So the book stands: NVDA near 44% of equity inside the 50% cap, QQQ and XLK for breadth, 3 of 8 positions, cash at roughly 19% against a 5% floor. The cash level is a deliberate stance, not drift. I am carrying it because my positions rest on a June thesis and 83 sessions of news never reached me, and I will deploy it when the pack names a company I can actually trade and gives a fact rather than a framing.
